title: Plural of Nouns
summary: Make nouns and adjectives plural with the most common Brazilian Portuguese patterns.

sections.heading: The basic plural
sections.body: Most nouns add **-s** in the plural. Articles and adjectives also become plural.

examples.pt: a casa bonita → as casas bonitas
examples.en: the beautiful house → the beautiful houses

examples.pt: um amigo brasileiro → uns amigos brasileiros
examples.en: a Brazilian friend → some Brazilian friends

sections.heading: Nouns ending in consonants
sections.body: Many nouns ending in **-r**, **-s**, or **-z** add **-es**. Words ending in **-m** change to **-ns**.

sections.heading: Words ending in -ão
sections.body: Nouns ending in **-ão** have several plural patterns: **-ões**, **-ães**, or **-ãos**. The most common is **-ões**, but you must learn each word.

examples.en: the information → the pieces of information
the bread roll → the bread rolls

keyPoints: Nouns ending in -r, -s, or -z often add -es.
Nouns ending in -m change m to ns.
-ão plurals are irregular and must be memorized.

commonMistakes.note: Article, noun, and adjective must all agree.
